description: A React component for managing invoices, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting invoices using an API service.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of invoices from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating an invoice.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Sets the form state to edit an existing invoice.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes an invoice after user confirmation.
